name: Dragonfly BMO
description: The Phaetus Dragonfly BMO is the V6 groove-mount variant of the Dragonfly series, sharing the same bi-metallic heatbreak technology as the BMS but designed as a drop-in V6 replacement at 62.3mm tip-to-top. It retains the 500°C temperature rating and V6-compatible nozzle threading while offering a nickel-plated copper heater block. Heater cartridge and thermistor are sold separately.

thermalSpecs.thermistorType: not included (user-supplied, typically NTC 100K or PT1000)

physicalSpecs.mountType: V6 groove mount compatible (62.3mm tip-to-top, same as V6)

features: Bi-metallic heatbreak for superior thermal gradient
V6 groove mount for broad toolhead support
Larger melt zone than Dragonfly BMS
